results.title: Jeep has one limited-edition Wrangler called Whitecap Mojito arriving in India soon
results.description: Jeep is bringing a limited-edition Wrangler called the Whitecap Mojito Limited Edition based on Rubicon trim. It is coming with exterior and interior cosmetic additions and pays tribute to the original Willys MB Jeep as well.
